Do not modify the circuit or Hamiltonian. Infer parameter order from the OpenQASM 3 input declarations in their textual order. Qiskit Pauli labels run from q[n-1] on the left to q[0] on the right. Use only the provided circuit, Hamiltonian, optional noise model, optional measurement specification, and previous angle-energy observations.
